health_scope_note: Health assertions use finite raw OTLP collection samples from workload start through 15 seconds after its last segment. Collector first_at/last_at report collection coverage, not source scrape timestamps. SQL readiness separately gates all members before workload; continuous metric coverage is not implied. Full-run range-query samples also include bootstrap lookback and planned shutdown.
